status: declared by the pull request that closes #537 before any score was computed, as Eleonora ruled on #496 on 10 October 2026: a 'not yet published' flag for the OFR values before their first public date, and an input scaling so the skewed model solves. Nothing here is tuned on a scored day. No input is added to the panel's published columns, to metadata/sources.json or to contract.py, and none is on in any published declaration. The scaling was chosen by whether the median quantile regression's linear program returns a solution on the one design of #496 that failed (it solved under every rescaling tried on that design); it was not chosen by any score.
extends: metadata/unused_inputs.json (#477): the passers, scoring window, thresholds, horizons and the other groups are those declarations'. This file re-scores the dealer-and-segment group only.
passers: the five tier-1 passers of #428 (docs/pivot/risk-date-severity-result.md), as metadata/risk_date_severity.json declares them: risk_gbm, risk_gbm_base, risk_logistic, risk_logistic_base, risk_quantile_skewt_base. Their estimators, risk-date rule, inputs and the exact-zero forecast on other days are unchanged; only the declared group is added to the inputs.
control: each candidate's control is its own passer, scored by this script on the same scratch panel and fold grid, so a difference is the group's (and, for the skew-t form, the scaling's) and nothing else. The skew-t candidate is also paired against risk_quantile_skewt_base_minmax, the passer refitted with the same scaling, so the group's effect and the scaling's can be told apart.

ofr_not_yet_published.why: the OFR began publishing its repo-segment series in real time on this day; earlier values were filled in after the fact and are not read (#508, #522). The panel carries ofr_tri_rate and ofr_gcf_rate empty before it.
ofr_not_yet_published.flag: <series>_not_yet_published: 1.0 on a row dated before first_public, else 0.0. A function of the row's date alone, never of whether a value exists: the GCF 'observed' indicator is not an input (Eleonora's ruling of 10 October 2026 on #520).
ofr_not_yet_published.value: <series>_filled: the panel's rate where it has one; 0.0 on a flagged row; empty otherwise. A gap after first_public is not filled, and a fit that needs the column refuses that day.

ofr_gcf_rate.why_not_scored: the GCF rate is empty on most days after first_public (144 of 1325 scratch-panel rows up to 2025-12-31 hold a value). Reading it would drop those days, and filling them would make a value's existence an input, which the ruling on #520 refuses. The flag and the filled column are built and tested, and the GCF rate stays out of every candidate. A fill for the GCF gaps is a design choice for Eleonora.

ofr_not_yet_published.guard: scripts/unused_inputs.py panel and run call dvp_segment.require_ofr_public (#522, of #508): a panel holding an OFR value dated before first_public raises LookAheadError. Both new column pairs draw on the OFR source's own fields, so the as-of rule reads them at that source's release lag.

scaling.rule: each column rescaled to [0, 1] on the fit's training pairs, then the linear programs (ml._scale_inputs). A linear quantile regression with an intercept is equivariant to the change, so the model is the same; only the solver's conditioning changes. The five passers and every other candidate keep the standardizer.
scaling.why: risk_quantile_skewt_base_dealer could not be fitted at h = 1 and h = 5 in #496: the median's program on the standardized design returned no solution (HiGHS status 4).
scaling.if_a_fit_still_fails: the candidate is reported as not scored, as in #496. No second scaling is tried in this pull request.

dealer_ofr.label: dealer and segment, with the OFR tri-party rate
dealer_ofr.source: dealer_treasury_position: nyfed_fr2004, six business days after the as-of date (published panel column, weekly, staleness-guarded); fed_repo_*: nyfed_repo_ops, 16:00 ET on the next business day (#425), the conservative reading, not the same-day one; tri_rate_filled and tri_rate_not_yet_published: ofr_stfm_repo_segments, 2 business days after the ref_date at 16:00 (the registry's release lag), flag by date only

columns_at_horizon: every group column is read at every horizon; the passers' own rule that treasury_settlement and treasury_settlement_coupons leave the inputs at h >= 2 is unchanged
new_availability_guard: none beyond the two above: the flag and the filled column are read through the as-of rule at the OFR source's own lag, and the panel is refused if it holds an OFR value dated before first_public
judge: scripts/pressure_judge.py judge, tiers 1, 3 and 5 under the rule in force; flag cut-offs chosen by metadata/pressure_judge.json's cutoff_rule from each refit's training window alone; none is declared here
published_declaration: none: no candidate is in confirmation.candidates and no column is in contract.FEATURE_FIELDS; nothing here is published, and no 2026 day is scored
